paper: P1GPT: a multi-agent LLM workflow module for multi-modal financial information analysis
claim_boundary: A researcher-authored monthly U.S.-stock implementation of P1GPT's five-layer dependency-aware multi-agent workflow and confidence/risk decision layer; not a replay of future-contaminated author positions or the unreleased private model service.

primary_source_anchors.mechanism: A five-layer Input, Planning, Analysis, Integration, and Decision workflow transforms multimodal financial information into one actionable recommendation.
A Controller decomposes the task, assigns dependency-aware work to Fundamental, Technical, Semiconductor, News, Search, Revenue, Trend, and Recommendation agents, and standardizes their outputs.
Domain agents execute independently where possible, supporting agents depend on their outputs, and an Integration layer resolves conflicting evidence before recommendation.

The Decision layer combines integrated evidence, confidence, risk assessment, and strategy planning into Buy, Sell, or Hold; native simulation enters at the same-day close and holds state until a later decision.

workflow_policy.controller: validate inputs and route every stock-month through all available domain and supporting agents
workflow_policy.external_search_agent: equal blend of fundamental and news reports
workflow_policy.revenue_forecasting_agent: equal blend of fundamental and semiconductor-cycle reports
workflow_policy.market_trend_agent: equal blend of technical and semiconductor-cycle reports
workflow_policy.investment_recommendation_agent: median of four domain and three supporting reports
workflow_policy.integration_rule: 0.75 times cross-agent median plus 0.25 times cross-agent mean
workflow_policy.confidence: one minus cross-agent population standard deviation, clipped to zero through one
workflow_policy.action_rule: BUY for positive integrated score, SELL for negative integrated score, HOLD when confidence is below 0.35
workflow_policy.common_portfolio_adapter: the continuous decision score enters frozen value-weighted long-short deciles and all six cost/missing-return paths

preserved_elements: five Input, Planning, Analysis, Integration, and Decision layers
a Controller that decomposes and routes work
Fundamental, Technical, Semiconductor, and News domain roles
External Search, Revenue Forecasting, Market Trend, and Investment Recommendation supporting roles
standardized numeric reports for cross-agent integration
median-based conflict resolution across heterogeneous reports
risk assessment before the final action
Buy, Sell, and Hold output semantics
approximated_elements: JKP value and quality ranks replace filing and analyst-estimate inputs
JKP momentum and risk ranks replace real-time technical data
earnings/sales surprises and attention replace semiconductor supply-chain and news retrieval
deterministic blends replace private Search, Revenue, and Trend model calls
numeric median/mean integration replaces LLM cross-agent reasoning
the common decile portfolio replaces single-stock long-only close execution
invented_elements: the exact signed JKP features for every domain role
the 0.80 evidence and 0.20 risk decision weights
